entry.title: PotentialPatina 1.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPatina 1.5.0** - **USER presets.** A new USER page with 8 slots: tap **SAVE**, then a slot, to keep the sound you have now; tap a slot to bring it back. entry.title: PotentialPatina 1.3.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPatina 1.3.0** - **ERA**: one tap sets all six sections for a sound of its time: Patina, '50s 78, '60s 45, '70s Tape, '80s Sampler, '90s Cassette, AM Radio and VHS. They're in the MPC's PRESET menu too. - **AGE**: clean to fully worn in one move. As it rises, the sections come in one after another (tone first, then drive, noise, wobble, and digital and space last). 50 % is the sound exactly as set, so projects from before sound the same; above that everything keeps going, well past it

entry.title: PotentialPatina 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialPatina 1.2.0** - **ROLL**: one tap switches on a random set of sections with random settings, for a new kind of old sound each time. **MILD** keeps it subtle (no digital crunch or room), **MEDIUM** may add them, **WILD** turns most things on and up. OUTPUT is left alone. Keep rolling until you like it, then fine-tune. - MAGNITUDE, MIX and OUTPUT moved up a little to make room for it. Two parameters were added at the end of the list (Roll, Roll Wildness); saved projects open as before.
